description: Java source code for the AlarmController class, which is an Android Activity used to schedule and manage alarms (one-shot and repeating) using AlarmManager, with UI buttons for user interactions.

classes.name: AlarmController
classes.description: Main activity for scheduling alarms, handling button clicks to set or cancel one-shot and repeating alarms.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity UI, sets up button click listeners for alarm controls.

methods.name: mOneShotListener
methods.description: Handles scheduling a one-shot alarm to go off after 30 seconds.

methods.name: mStartRepeatingListener
methods.description: Handles scheduling a repeating alarm starting after 15 seconds, repeating every 15 seconds.
